page: Microsoft Azure DC64ads_cc_v5 is a general-purpose virtual machine powered by the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 32 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 7763 processor running at 3.525 GHz. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. Local storage is bundled, featuring 2458 GB of local disk capacity with Premium Storage capabilities.

Benchmark evaluations indicate strong multi-core capabilities, with stress-ng multi-core CPU performance and Geekbench multi-core scores placing in the top 25%. Passmark memory benchmarks rank in the top 10%, supported by a cached small-block read-only memory bandwidth of 4184.42 GB/sec. Database operations are highly efficient, with Passmark database operations and Redis SET operations (63.02 million operations per second) both scoring in the top 25%. However, single-core performance is more moderate, with Geekbench single-core and single-threaded gzip compression falling into the middle 50%.

While the server excels at multi-threaded tasks and database workloads, it presents clear tradeoffs in large-scale machine learning. LLM inference text generation using a large 70B model is weak, registering at 2.74 tokens per second, though smaller model inference remains average to strong. Given the balanced resource allocation and high local storage capacity, this server is optimized for database hosting, multi-threaded data processing, Redis caching, and general-purpose enterprise workloads.
